data.name: Imroz
data.gender_notes: Imroz is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Imroz is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Marut', which refers to the gods of wind and rain. In Hindu mythology, these gods are known to bring life-giving rains during the monsoon season. Thus, the name Imroz symbolizes fertility, renewal, and abundance. The name Imroz carries the meaning “God of Rain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Imroz usually hope their child will grow to embody god of rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Imroz belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imroz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
